novelty_flags.label: thm:product-testing-converse and thm:uniform-minimax-frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: The direct causal-direction sample-complexity literature omits Acharya et al. (2023) for two-variable causal-structure testing and Jin (2026) for sharp bivariate LiNGAM direction minimax bounds; both are orthogonal rather than subsuming, but are closer comparators than the listed generic testing analogies.

soundness_flags.label: def:feasible-set, symbol kappaH, and thm:attainable-margin-rectangle
soundness_flags.one_line: The rectangle is stated only after an unspecified theta-dependent coordinate placement, while kappaH(a) uses a vector t and theta without defining the one-coordinate path; define a permutation Pi_theta and the scalar-coordinate limit before asserting box inclusion.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-generated-residual-expansion; thm:uniform-minimax-frontier; thm:simultaneous-graph-confidence-set
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The learned-residual statistic and its fourth-order uniform expansion are not yet derived; the matching upper frontier and singleton guarantee depend on an affirmative resolution of that OEQ.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lambda^{-1} upper minimax bound and confidence-set singleton transition are claimed only conditional on the specified orthogonal generated-residual expansion and the displayed nuisance inequality r_n^4 <= c lambda.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Condition 19 defines identifiable bivariate ANMs; Definition 27 defines restricted ANMs; Theorem 28 identifies the graph under restricted ANM plus causal minimality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 14-15, Equation (6), Definition 8, Theorem 9; pp. 51-52, Theorem 20
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The fixed-kernel residual-HSIC procedure is consistent under suitable regression, and the fitted-residual HSIC converges to population HSIC.
HSIC is the squared Hilbert-Schmidt cross-covariance norm; bounded kernels yield a finite-sample deviation bound, and universal kernels give HSIC zero iff independence on the stated domains.
Li et al. (2025) is an ICML/PMLR paper that introduces GENE as an order-based causal-discovery framework incorporating conditional-independence tests into order-fitness evaluation.

source_verification_receipts.version: public preprint corresponding to the subsequently cited JASA article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs residual-bootstrap confidence sets for causal orderings and establishes asymptotic validity; the cited JASA publication metadata was independently confirmed.
The paper gives upper and lower sample-complexity tradeoffs for two-variable causal-structure identification using observational and interventional samples on finite domains.

The preprint states a sharp bivariate LiNGAM minimax direction law depending on edge strength, non-Gaussianity, and scale uncertainty; it is a linear LiNGAM result rather than the proposed nonlinear ANM result.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Acharya et al. (2023) and Jin (2026) to related work, explicitly distinguish intervention/discrete CSI and linear-LiNGAM primitive margins from the nonlinear residual-HSIC product experiment.

Define Pi_theta on the ordered (H_{j,+},H_{j,-}) block and restate the feasible-image result as Pi_theta(Gamma_d(P,theta)) containing the displayed rectangle; define kappaH through a scalar t_j path with all other coordinates fixed.

Promote the unconditional attainable-rectangle plus legal-mirror lower bound as the field headline, and present the generated-residual OEQ as the explicitly required route to a matched upper theorem rather than letting the conditional upper carry the novelty claim.

Test whether the orthogonal residual construction can be reduced to an explicit second-order U-statistic influence-function formula and state its nuisance tangent/projection space; this would convert the OEQ from a handle into a more falsifiable construction program.

recommended_next_step: Revise the coordinate-level formulation and literature map, then advance the unconditional geometry/mirror kernel while retaining the upper frontier only under the accepted generated-residual scope caveat.
